iter_brennan2019_recordings: iterate over all Brennan2019 EEG recordings by calling Brennan2019Recording.iter() to yield each subject
load_raw_eeg_for_subject: load raw EEG data for a subject by creating a Brennan2019Recording and calling its _load_raw method
load_events_for_subject: load event annotations for a subject by creating a Brennan2019Recording and calling its _load_events method
download_and_prepare_brennan2019_data: download and extract the Brennan2019 audio and proc zip files from the University of Michigan repository
read_eeg_mat_file: read a .mat EEG file and return an MNE RawArray with 62 channels at 500 Hz sampling rate
